ui.add_weekly_full_scan: Ongeraho isuzuma ryuzuye rya buri cyumweru
ui.an_administrator_must_give_a_reason: Umuyobozi agomba gutanga impamvu. Ibisonerwa byandikwa mu mateka y'igenzura.
ui.automatic_protection_keeps_running_on: Uburinzi bwikora bukomeza gukora kuri buri gikoresho. Ibi ni ibikorwa bikeneye ko umuntu afata icyemezo.
ui.by_default_the_agent_sends_security: Mu buryo busanzwe intumwa yohereza telemetry y'umutekano na hash z'amadosiye: amazina y'ibikorwa n'imirongo y'amabwiriza, inzira z'amadosiye, amakuru y'ihuza ry'umuyoboro, n'ibyabonetse. Ibikubiye mu madosiye bikusanywa gusa iyo ikigo cyawe kibifunguye.
ui.during_the_free_trial_and_on: Mu gihe cy'igerageza ry'ubuntu, no ku migambi itishyuwe, konsole yerekana kwamamaza kwa Google AdSense naho porogaramu za telefone zigaragaza kwamamaza kwa Google AdMob, nyuma yo kugusaba uruhushya. Abafite ifatabuguzi babona kwamamaza kugabanutse ku kigero cya 95%. Kwamamaza ntikugera kugaragara ku mapaji y'ibyemezo, ikumira, integuza z'ibitero, isuzuma ry'akato, kwinjira, kwishyura cyangwa igenzura.
ui.each_publish_creates_a_new_signed: Buri gutangaza bikora verisiyo nshya isinyiwe. Ibikoresho bikomeza gukurikiza verisiyo iheruka yemejwe igihe bitari kuri murandasi.
ui.equality_software_ltd_operates_agenti: Equality Software Ltd ni yo ikoresha Agentic Antivirus. Uru rupapuro rusobanura ibyo serivisi ikusanya. Rugomba gusuzumwa na nyir'igicuruzwa mbere yo gutangazwa.
ui.every_action_that_changes_a_device: Buri gikorwa gihindura igikoresho, konti cyangwa urujya n'uruza kinyura muri moteri ya politiki n'imiyoborere ya AEP-X. Icyemezo kireba igikorwa kimwe, ibigenderewe byacyo nyabyo, iki kigo, n'igihe cyagenwe.
ui.every_upload_is_checked_for_malware: Buri cyoherejwe gisuzumwa niba kirimo malware n'ubwoko bwacyo nyabwo. Amadosiye adafite igaragaza ryemejwe arabikwa kandi ashobora kumanurwa ariko ntagaragazwa mbere.
ui.for_access_or_correction_requests: ku busabe bwo kugera ku makuru cyangwa kuyakosora.
ui.get_the_agent_for_windows_mac: Bona intumwa ya Windows, Mac cyangwa Linux kuri
ui.go_to_devices_choose_enrol_a: Jya kuri Ibikoresho, uhitemo Andikisha igikoresho, hanyuma ukore itegeko rigaragara kuri mudasobwa ushaka kurinda. Intumwa itangira gusuzuma ikimara kwakira politiki yayo isinyiwe.
ui.i_understand_devices_will_stop_scanni: Ndumva ko ibikoresho bizahagarika gusuzuma no guhagarika ibitero nyuma y'igerageza kugeza ifatabuguzi ryishyuwe.
ui.include_the_language_model_if_your: Shyiramo moderi y'ururimi (niba ikigo cyawe cyayifunguye)
ui.known_malware_is_moved_to_quarantine: Malware izwi ijyanwa mu kato, aho idashobora gukora. Niba utekereza ko dosiye yahagaritswe ku bw'ikosa, fungura Akato hanyuma usabe isuzuma. Umuyobozi ni we ufata icyemezo, kandi dosiye igaruka gusa nyuma y'uko isuzuma rishya risanze isukuye.
ui.languages_without_a_complete_translat: Indimi zidafite ubusemuzi bwuzuye zigaragaza Icyongereza. Aho ubusemuzi bugeze harapimwa, ntihakekwa.
ui.management_hosts_kept_reachable_durin: Host z'ubuyobozi zikomeza kugerwaho mu gihe cy'itandukanywa
ui.name: Izina
ui.name_of_the_secret_in_your: Izina ry'ibanga mu bubiko bwawe bw'amabanga, si ibanga ubwaryo
ui.on_android_subscribe_in_the_agentic: Kuri Android, fata ifatabuguzi muri porogaramu ya Agentic Antivirus binyuze kuri Google Play. Kuri iPhone na iPad, ifatabuguzi rya App Store ntiriraboneka. Kwishyura kuri murandasi ntibiraboneka.
ui.per_user_covers_all_of_their: Kuri buri mukoresha (bireba ibikoresho bye byose)
ui.read_aloud_and_dictation_use_your: Gusoma mu ijwi no kwandika ukoresheje ijwi bikoresha ibiranga imvugo byubatswe muri mushakisha yawe. Ntitwandika cyangwa ngo tubike amajwi.
ui.stopping_processes_isolating_devices_: Guhagarika ibikorwa, gutandukanya ibikoresho, kugarura amadosiye, kongeraho ibisonerwa no guhindura amategeko y'urujya n'uruza bikeneye ko umuntu abyemeza. Icyemezo kireba igikorwa kimwe, ibigenderewe byacyo nyabyo n'igihe gito cyagenwe. Niba hari ikintu gihindutse, ongera wemeze.
ui.subscribe_this_device_with_google_pla: Fata ifatabuguzi kuri iki gikoresho ukoresheje Google Play
ui.the_assistant_groups_related_alerts_l: Umufasha ahuriza hamwe integuza zifitanye isano, agashyira ku rutonde ibyagaragaye n'amahuza ajya ku bimenyetso, kandi agashyira nk'igitekerezo icyo ari cyo cyose adashobora guhamya. Ashobora gusaba ibikorwa ariko ntashobora kubyemeza. Niba moderi itaboneka, isuzuma, integuza n'ibisubizo bikozwe n'intoki bikomeza gukora.
ui.tls_only_must_be_on_the: TLS gusa, igomba kuba ku rutonde rwemewe rwo gusohoka
ui.traffic_floods_are_absorbed_by_your: Imyuzure y'urujya n'uruza yakirwa n'utanga serivisi wawe wo hejuru. Hano ubarura buri aho kugera rusange, ugenzura integuza z'utanga serivisi, kandi ukemeza imipaka mishya y'urujya n'uruza.
ui.turn_on_protection_to_scan_files: Fungura uburinzi kugira ngo usuzume amadosiye kuri iyi mudasobwa kandi ugenzure ransomware n'ubujura bw'ibyangombwa byo kwinjira.
ui.we_show_adverts_from_google_adsense: Twerekana kwamamaza kwa Google AdSense ku mapaji amwe. Wemera kwamamaza kugenewe wowe?
ui.you_can_delete_your_account_from: Ushobora gusiba konti yawe uhereye ku mwirondoro wawe. Andikira
ui.your_organisation_gets_a_30_day: Ikigo cyawe kibona igerageza ry'ubuntu ry'iminsi 30. Nyuma y'aho bigura £4,99 ku kwezi kuri buri mukoresha cyangwa igikoresho.
ui.your_organisation_sets_how_long_telem: Ikigo cyawe ni cyo kigena igihe telemetry n'ibimenyetso bibikwa. Inyandiko z'igenzura ntizishobora guhindurwa cyangwa gusibwa.
